title: The Due column describes each standard term in words
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop has every standard term switched on, and you read how the Due column describes each one.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • All twelve standard terms are active and COD is the default for new customers.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps: 1. Read the Due column for every row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: COD reads "Paid when the invoice is created"; Due on Receipt reads "Due on the invoice date"; Net 7 reads "7 days after the invoice date", Net 15 "15 days after the invoice date", Net 20 "20 days after the invoice date", Net 30 "30 days after the invoice date", Net 45 "45 days after the invoice date", Net 50 "50 days after the invoice date", Net 60 "60 days after the invoice date", Net 90 "90 days after the invoice date", Net 120 "120 days after the invoice date"; Credit Hold reads "Invoicing is blocked".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list)

  • S1-R7: “The Due column describes each term in words:”
  • S1-R7, COD: “COD: "Paid when the invoice is created"”
  • S1-R7, Due on Receipt: “Due on Receipt: "Due on the invoice date"”
  • S1-R7, Credit Hold: “Credit Hold: "Invoicing is blocked"”
  • S1-R7, a Net term: “A Net term: "{X} days after the invoice date" ("1 day after the invoice date" when X is 1), for example "30 days after the invoice date"”
  • Key Decisions: “The page explains every term inline in a Due column; only COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold carry an info tooltip.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
